human_annotated_paired_UI_Scry.dataset: Scry Design Diff Eval 311 pairs, 557 human-tagged individual issues, 77 no-tagged control pairs, 52 app groups
human_annotated_paired_UI_Scry.no_tagged_caveat: No-tagged controls are NOT independently certified defect-free; no-tagged flag rate is diagnostic rather than proven false-positive rate
human_annotated_paired_UI_Scry.localization_caveat: Spatial IoU >= 0.10 against human boxes without predicting issue class, so cannot be compared with the official category-and-location recall reported for contemporary VLMs

W3C_ACT_color_contrast.rule: afw4f7 WCAG 1.4.3 Minimum, independent W3C ACT testcases
W3C_ACT_color_contrast.checker: Firefox 146 computed CSS colors, opacity/background approximation; no axe-core; frozen rule before expected outcomes scored
W3C_ACT_color_contrast.decision: CANNOT serve as complete contrast checker: abstentions and false applicability decisions, despite correct decisions on some flat-color cases
W3C_ACT_color_contrast.limitations: No reliable checking of CSS gradients/background images, pseudo element text, icon text, active scripts or rendered font pixels. ACT labels for document semantic applicability may not match static style approximation; abstention preferred. Case-specific text can be below viewport but its CSS still computed.
